llm.summary: This skill is a read-only guide for querying public Google Play data through ReplyNodes, with no evidence of hidden execution, credential theft, persistence, or write access.

dimensions.detail: Network access to https://api.replynodes.com and an optional ReplyNodes API key are purpose-aligned, but users should be aware requests may be metered and should check capabilities before bulk use.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown documentation and JSON metadata only; no executable scripts, dependency installs, remote code loading, or install-time hooks were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions explicitly prohibit Google account credentials, cookies, OAuth sessions, publishing, private data access, catalog enumeration, and write operations; they also require bounded pagination and input validation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, local indexing, browser/session access, or local file mutation behavior is present in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is retrieving public Android app data as normalized JSON, and the documented capabilities are read-only GET routes for app details, search, reviews, permissions, categories, availability, and data safety.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you are comfortable sending Google Play lookup terms and package IDs to ReplyNodes, keep any ReplyNodes API key in an environment variable, and check the capabilities endpoint for rate limits or metered costs before running batches.
llm.findings:
[YR1] expected: The matched text is safety language saying the skill never uses credentials, cookies, OAuth sessions, publishing paths, catalog enumeration, or write operations; the inspected artifacts contain no malware payload or credential-harvesting instructions.
[EA2] expected: The phrase 'Do not ask the user' appears in the context of telling agents not to request account signup or pasted credentials, not autonomous high-impact action.
[E1] expected: The external URL is the disclosed ReplyNodes API endpoint needed for the skill's stated function, and the artifact instructs users not to send Google credentials or expose API keys.
